caption: The drawing depicts a single, tall bottle with a hexagonal shape standing upright in the center of the image. The bottle is colored in various shades of light green, with darker green and yellowish highlights to suggest transparency and reflection. The surface of the bottle features a pattern made of pointed arch-like shapes outlined with darker green. The neck of the bottle is slightly wider and ringed, with a flared, rounded lip at the top. The bottle occupies most of the inner rectangular frame, which is lightly sketched within the beige background of the paper. There are minor spots and marks visible on the background to the right of the bottle. The overall composition centers the bottle within a plain, undecorated background.
title: Jersey Milk Bottle
